instruction: Load the unpacked helloExtension Chrome extension from your Desktop and check that it is listed among your browser extensions.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires loading unpacked Chrome extension from Desktop and verifying the extension name 'Hello Extensions' appears in the installed extensions list. Based on manifest.json, the extension name is 'Hello Extensions'. Custom getter extracts all extension names from Chrome preferences, and metric checks if the expected name is in the list.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts extension names from Chrome Preferences file by reading manifest data - this is the right state for verification
Metric correctly checks if expected extension name 'Hello Extensions' is present in the list returned by getter
Complete coverage: instruction requires verifying extension appears in extension list, evaluator checks exactly this
Correct parameter handling: metric uses expected.get('expected_name') which correctly accesses the rules dict when expected.type='rule'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'Hello Extensions' matches the actual extension name from manifest.json according to metadata
No UI state dependency: getter reads from Chrome preferences file which persists after installation, no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: getter returns empty list on error, metric returns 0.0 if name not found
